A Night on the Lanes

Great science thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and the occasional break from the lab bench. To foster these connections and recharge as a team, our lab recently hosted its first-ever social event: a bowling night! It was a fantastic evening filled with friendly competition, plenty of laughter, and great conversation outside the research setting. We look forward to hosting more of these gatherings as we continue to innovate and advance science together.
